## Choosing the extraction method

Magnetic beads on the robot (EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG) are the standard. Use spin columns (EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL) for samples that may yield little DNA: small samples, samples with few animals, and precious samples.

## Steps, protocols and bench sheets

| Step | Protocol | Bench sheet | Passed on | QC gate |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1. Sampling, MacFadyen extraction, sorting | [EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH](../protocols/fauna/EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH.qmd) | [bench sheet](../bench/EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH-bench.qmd) | Sorted animals in ethanol 96% | Extraction within 5 days of sampling; temperature gradient |
| 2a. DNA extraction, magnetic beads (standard) | [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG.qmd) | [bench sheet](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG-bench.qmd) | DNA extract, 50 µL | Extraction blanks (4 per plate) |
| 2b. DNA extraction, spin columns (low-DNA samples) | [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL.qmd) | [bench sheet](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL-bench.qmd) | DNA extract | Extraction blanks |
| 3. Nucleic acid QC: purity, then concentration (plates or single samples) | [EnGeL-MOLB-NANODROP](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-NANODROP.qmd); [EnGeL-MOLB-PICOGREEN](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-PICOGREEN.qmd) or [EnGeL-MOLB-QUBIT](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-QUBIT.qmd) | [NanoDrop](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-NANODROP-bench.qmd), [PicoGreen](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-PICOGREEN-bench.qmd), [Qubit](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-QUBIT-bench.qmd) | DNA extract with concentration and purity | ≥ 10 ng/µL go; < 5 ng/µL fail; 5–10 ng/µL the PCR decides |
| 4. Library preparation | [EnGeL-MOLB-MB](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-MB.qmd) | [bench sheet](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-MB-bench.qmd) | Cleaned, pooled library | PCR1 gel; negatives clean; TapeStation single peak |
| 5. Library quantification | [EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA.qmd) (also inside EnGeL-MOLB-MB) | [bench sheet](../bench/EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA-bench.qmd) | Pool diluted to 4 nM | qPCR run criteria (in the protocol) |
| 6. Sequencing submission | [Sequencing submission](sequencing-submission.qmd) | – | FASTQ files from the provider | – |
| 7. Bioinformatics | [EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4](../protocols/bioinf/EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4.qmd) | – | Curated OTU table and identifications | – |
| 8. Community data in R | [EnGeL-BIOINF-COMMUNITY](../protocols/bioinf/EnGeL-BIOINF-COMMUNITY.qmd) | – | Identified OTUs; incidence table; shared OTUs between groups | Samples read = samples sequenced |
| 9. Sampling effort and completeness | [EnGeL-SAMPL-EFFORT](../protocols/sampl/EnGeL-SAMPL-EFFORT.qmd) | – | Sample coverage; rarefaction and extrapolation curves; estimated richness | Sample coverage (criterion to confirm) |

Other protocols: [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BARC](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BARC.qmd) (single specimens for barcoding), [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BEE](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BEE.qmd) (honey bee guts), [EnGeL-MOLB-RNA](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-RNA.qmd) (total RNA). See also the workflows for [single-specimen barcoding](single-specimen-barcoding.qmd) and [RNA](rna.qmd), both in preparation.
